theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn h M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 < μ (M ∩ ball x s)) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, φ x * h x ∂μ = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, h x = 0
